name: web-dev
description: A harness for web application development in JavaScript/TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, Node, Express, NestJS, Fastify, Hono) — new projects and existing ones. Question-first intake with options, an approved task brief instead of plan mode, hook-enforced gates (manifest, security, no code comments, default-branch protection, dependency approval), self-auditing code/API/UI/data maps with per-function notes that never go stale, Playwright responsive checks, a supervisor review, and a branch → PR → /clear cycle. Requires Node 20+, git and Claude Code v2.1.200+ (macOS, Linux, Windows).
